name: darian-agent-plugins
description: Agent plugins for Claude Code — real-time ESLint diagnostics via LSP, and more.

plugins.name: ts-eslint-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript LSP proxy with unified real-time ESLint diagnostics. Preserves all TypeScript intelligence while adding ESLint push diagnostics into Claude's context.

plugins.description: Real-time ESLint diagnostics for Claude Code via a lightweight LSP server. No vscode-eslint dependency. Supports ESLint v9+ flat config. Bundled with @eslint/mcp for AI-callable autofix.

plugins.name: ai-flow
plugins.description: Generic data-driven AI workflow engine with human-approval gates, cross-session state persistence, and mechanically-enforced hooks.
